meta.name: Al norte del norte
meta.description: Una mujer joven y optimista busca reinventarse en su pequeña localidad natal en el Ártico. Pero, como se sabe, pueblo chico…, infierno grande.

videos.title: Top of the World
videos.overview: Feeling stuck in her life in her tiny Arctic community, Siaja decides it's time to shake things up during the annual Spring Festival, but her plans are derailed by personal upheavals.

videos.title: No Freeloading
videos.overview: Siaja struggles to pick up the pieces and prove herself capable of handling more than just her messy personal life.

videos.title: Dumpcano
videos.overview: Siaja’s first day of work goes awry when she accidentally starts a fire at the dump and Alistair and Kuuk visit the community center to discuss Ice Cove's candidacy to host a polar research station.

videos.title: Joy to the Effing World
videos.overview: With Kuuk’s help, Siaja forms a plan to shake up Elder’s night by coaxing children to attend, hoping to raise the Elders’ spirits. Meanwhile, Neevee seems to run into Alistair everywhere she goes.

videos.title: Walrus Dick Baseball
videos.overview: Ice Cove is shortlisted for the polar research station, so Siaja proposes they host a baseball fundraiser to afford upgrades to the community centre to better their chances. Helen is coerced into a winner-takes-all bet by the rival town’s leader.

videos.title: Carnivores
videos.overview: Love is not in the air in Ice Cove as Siaja re-enters the dating world in epic style, Neevee and Alistair reach a turning point, and Kuuk has a surprise visitor.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: The community comes together for an exhausting multi-day search for Ting. Siaja entrusts Alistair to babysit Bun during the search.

videos.title: Bad Influences
videos.overview: Siaja and Helen put the final touches on their pitch for the polar research station, when Helen is pulled away. Siaja uses this opportunity to view the only available apartment in town with Kuuk’s help.

videos.title: I Wanna Mask Dance With Somebody
videos.overview: It's winter in Ice Cove and young single mother Siaja is trying to adjust. She organizes a mask dance to boost tourism and it spirals into chaos. Meanwhile, a mysterious discovery in Neevee's house raises a lot of questions.

videos.title: Ice, Ice, Baby
videos.overview: Siaja turns to Alistair to help her solve a sudden water crisis, Neevee applies for a grant to grow her store while Siaja's Winter Ball idea is approved. Mother and daughter are dreaming big, with important projects to thrown themselves into.

videos.title: Code Blue
videos.overview: When a first-aid training session out on the ice goes wrong, Siaja and Millie team up to solve the crisis. Elsewhere, Kuuk and Alistair help each other process their respective romantic struggles.

videos.title: Fast and Flirtatious
videos.overview: When Siaja discovers her ex has moved on, she and her friends organize a community speed dating event, leading to unexpected outcomes. Meanwhile, Alistair has his own adventure with Bun.

videos.title: Beer Quest
videos.overview: A birthday celebration for Millie takes a chaotic turn when a delivery goes wrong, leading to an unexpected run-in with the law; amidst the trouble, Siaja receives life-changing news.

videos.title: Missing Pieces
videos.overview: Siaja travels south on a mission to investigate the whereabouts of her long-lost sister; Siaja arrives in the city with a clear plan, but absolutely does not stick to it.

videos.title: Ghosted
videos.overview: Following a personal setback, Siaja struggles with her commitment to the Winter Ball and her relationships. A trip out onto the land with Neevee leads to a long-overdue, honest conversation.

videos.title: Experrrrt
videos.overview: As the night of the Winter Ball arrives, so does a massive storm which threatens to derail the event. Siaja and her friends have to dig deep to keep the ball alive.
